Access Engineering profit more than doubles 🏗️📈

Access Engineering PLC (AEL) made a profit of Rs 4.08 billion for shareholders in the July to September 2026 quarter. That is 158% more than a year ago.

Revenue grew 36% to Rs 20.39 billion. Gross margin improved to 29.7%, from 24.7% a year ago.

For the first six months, profit was Rs 5.79 billion, up 128%.

Source: AEL interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/1141_1794482623341.pdf
